scope: Research only. Corrects or excludes the share count that enters the PIT market capitalization of the V10 factor panel (scripts/quant/v10/factor/factors.cjs#marketCapAt: shares x close(t) x split factor at the share date). Opt-in via quant/engines/research-pit-market-cap.cjs; the V10 function, the product engines (fundamental-inputs.js, market-cap.js) and all */data artefacts stay unchanged.
priorKnowledge: Before this rule was written, exactly these cases were inspected in the raw companyfacts facts (no factor-study outcome was computed on corrected data): EEFT 10-K FY2020 (dei 5.2752851e16, WASO 52.66 M), CB 10-Q Q1/Q2 2010 (whole filing x1e6 incl. comparative 2009-12-31), ON 10-Q 2012/2013 (dei x1e6, CSSO correct), YUM 10-Q Q3 2016 (dei x1e6, no CSSO, WASO 392 M), ORCL 10-Q Q1 FY2013 (dei x1e6, CSSO correct), Citigroup 10-Q Q3 2009 (CSSO 22,863,947) and the Citigroup 1:10 reverse split 2011-05-09 (dei cover-date value after the split carried with a period end before the split).
V11 counts known from the brief: 149 panel rows > 5e12 USD, about 2 % implied share counts > 5x the listing median, Tiingo spin-off factors GE 1.281/1.253 and IBM 1.046 in the split lists.
pointInTime: Every reference used for a share observation O was filed no later than O itself: facts of the same accession (filed = O.filed) and facts of earlier accessions (filed < O.filed). O.filed < t by construction of the V10 panel (cutoff t-1). Split events are used only with event date <= t. A split-register classification is used at t only if its evidence was available at t (availableAt <= t-1); otherwise the event counts as unresolved at t.

inputs.observations: V10 factor panel market-cap inputs (scripts/quant/v12/mcap/observations.cjs): doc.ttm.shares_outstanding {v, end E, filed, accn, concept} per listing x rank date, close(t), split factors of the listing
inputs.rawFacts: SEC companyfacts bulk archive (non-dimensional facts), concepts dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (ECSO), us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding (CSSO), us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic (WASO_B), us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding (WASO_D), us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfShareOutstandingBasicAndDiluted (WASO_BD), us-gaap:CommonStockSharesIssued (CSSI, comparative-scaling check only), including registered predecessor CIKs
inputs.splits: split list of the research loader {identityEvidence, corporateActionEvidence} (provider factors)

steps.rule: Find the raw fact of O: same accession, same concept, |val - v| <= 1e-6 * v. Its end date is the raw date D (for ECSO the cover date). Unmatched: D = E and flag RAW_FACT_UNMATCHED. A matched fact with unit other than 'shares' -> UNIT_ERROR (EXCLUDED).

The share basis is converted by date, not by weekly bar: market cap = v x close(t) x F(t) x prod of provider split factors with D < split date <= date(t). If this differs from the V10 factor (a provider split lies between E and D, or the V10 bar assignment put a split dated <= D into a later bar - the known same-week edge case), class SPLIT_TIMING, status CORRECTED; evidence = raw end date D of the same fact and the split date. All later comparisons use basis D.

A_out: other ECSO/CSSO facts of the same accession with |end - D| <= 120 d. A_w: WASO_B/WASO_D/WASO_BD facts of the same accession with |end - D| <= 120 d and duration <= 370 d. P1, P2: the latest ECSO/CSSO fact (latest end) of each of the two latest earlier accessions (filed < O.filed); if that earlier fact is itself an observation already classified by this rule (issuer facts are processed in filed order), its corrected value is used and an excluded one is skipped. All references are converted to basis D with the provider splits between their end and D (events classified NOT_A_SPLIT excluded). COMP: comparative check - pairs (same accession fact F with end e, earlier-filed fact of the same concept with the same end e), any share concept incl. CSSI; ratio q = F / earlier. (1.0.2) P1 is the issuer's latest earlier validated observation if one exists; P2 the latest earlier accession's fact. (1.0.6) P1/P2 are validated observations only; no raw fallback.

If the same accession carries >= 2 distinct non-dimensional ECSO values with the same end D and v is one of them: if v is within 2 % of an A_out CSSO or A_w value -> no multi-class issue; else if the sum of the distinct ECSO values is within 2 % of a CSSO or WASO value of the same accession -> v' = sum, class MULTI_CLASS_SUM, CORRECTED; else MULTI_CLASS_UNRESOLVED, EXCLUDED.

ref = median(A_out) if present, else median(A_w), else P1. Triggered if |log10(v/ref)| >= log10(5), or |log10(v/P1)| >= log10(5), or max market cap of O over its uses > 8e12 USD. Not triggered: OK (OK_NO_REFERENCE if no reference exists).

For a triggered O, in this order: (H1 scale) for each k in SCALE_EXPONENTS, v' = v / 10^k; prior-consistent means P1 exists and v' is within 25 % of P1. Tier A: v' within 2 % of a same-filing value (A_out or A_w) and prior-consistent; without P1, v' within 2 % of two distinct same-filing concepts. Tier B: |k| >= 3, some COMP pair with q within 2 % of 10^k (whole filing scaled), prior-consistent, and no COMP pair of O's own concept with q within 2 % of 1. Tier C: within 10 % of one same-filing value and within 10 % of P1. The best tier with exactly one k decides -> SCALE_ERROR, CORRECTED, factor 10^-k; two or more k in the best tier -> AMBIGUOUS_SCALE, EXCLUDED. (H0 value confirmed) v within 25 % of P1, or without P1 within 2 % of a same-filing outstanding value (A_out), or within 2 % of two distinct same-filing concepts -> OK, class GENUINE_CAPITAL_ACTION if P1 deviates >= 5x (then confirmation by a same-filing value within 2 % is required), else ALTERNATIVE_CONCEPT_DEVIATES. (H2) none -> UNRESOLVED, EXCLUDED; any remaining use above the absolute bound -> MCAP_ABSOLUTE_BOUND. (1.0.2) Every scale tier also needs support(v') > support(v) (references within 25 %: one per same-filing concept, P1, P2); class PRIOR_VINTAGE_SCALE_ERROR when the confirmed v differs from P1 by a power of ten. (1.0.3) 'Two distinct same-filing concepts' means two distinct source families ECSO, CSSO, WASO (all WASO variants are one family). (1.0.4) Tier B counts support on P1/P2 only. (1.0.6) Tier B comparison values must agree with P1 within 25 %; scale candidates must give 1e6 <= market cap <= 8e12 USD for every use. (1.0.7) Source families: COVER (ECSO) and STATEMENTS (CSSO and all WASO). (1.0.8) |k| < 3 -> DECIMAL_SCALE_SUSPECTED, EXCLUDED (never corrected).
After correction, any use with market cap > 8e12 USD -> MCAP_ABSOLUTE_BOUND, EXCLUDED (that use only).

Every provider split event of a listing in [2009-01-01, 2025-12-31] is classified by share continuity: S_before = last ECSO/CSSO fact with raw end < event date from an accession filed before the event date (originally reported, not a restated comparative), S_after = first with raw end >= event date (each within 200 d of the event), r = S_after / S_before. REAL_SPLIT if |ln r - ln f| <= 0.25 |ln f|; NOT_A_SPLIT if |ln r| <= 0.25 |ln f| and |ln f| >= ln 1.10; SMALL_FACTOR_ACCEPTED if |ln f| < ln 1.10 (continuity cannot discriminate; provider factor kept unless a SEC-sourced spin-off record says NOT_A_SPLIT); otherwise UNRESOLVED. availableAt = filed date of S_after (or of the SEC spin-off source). SEC-sourced spin-off records (8-K/10-K quote, accession, URL, sha256) override continuity and carry availableAt = filing date. (1.0.5) NOT_A_SPLIT only if the factor is not split-shaped; otherwise CONTRADICTED_SPLIT.

Per use (listing, t): market cap = v' x close(t) x F(t) x prod of provider split factors with D < split date <= date(t) that are not removed (F(t) = cumulative provider factor after t, as in V10). For each such event: NOT_A_SPLIT with availableAt <= t-1 -> factor removed (SPINOFF_AS_SPLIT, CORRECTED); SMALL_FACTOR_ACCEPTED or REAL_SPLIT with availableAt <= t-1 -> kept; a split-shaped factor (f or 1/f equal to an integer n <= 1000 or to p/q with p, q <= 10, relative tolerance 1e-4) whose classification is not yet available at t, or which is REAL_SPLIT/UNRESOLVED -> kept as provider split (the V10 assumption, public at t); a factor that is neither small nor split-shaped and is UNRESOLVED or not yet classified at t -> SPLIT_BASIS_UNRESOLVED, EXCLUDED. Status precedence EXCLUDED > CORRECTED > OK. (1.0.5) CONTRADICTED_SPLIT with availableAt <= t-1 -> SPLIT_BASIS_UNRESOLVED, EXCLUDED.

verification.sample: >= 40 corrected/excluded observations checked against the original filing (primary document or XBRL instance via scripts/quant/sec/http_client.py, <= 2 requests/s), with accession, URL, sha256 and quote <= 300 characters
verification.independentCheck: Python stdlib (python3 -I), own concept selection from companyfacts, own classification; agreement reported, not tuned

changePolicy: Any change after application is a new version with its own sha256, reason and disclosure of what was seen.

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The classification output of rule 1.0.0 on all 117,888 distinct share observations (classes, evidence, split classes) - no factor-study or winners-study result on corrected data had been computed.
findings: F1 (logic error): in 1.0.0 a same-filing alternative was trusted as the true value. In 259 of 748 SCALE_ERROR corrections the alternative itself was mis-scaled (CSSO or WASO tagged in thousands, e.g. ABCB 10-Q 2012: ECSO 23,814,144 correct, alternative 23,814 = thousands) and the correct ECSO was divided by 1,000; the prior vintage agreed with the uncorrected value.

F2 (logic error): the split-continuity test took as S_before the restated comparative balance-sheet value of the first post-split filing (already split-adjusted), so 424 events were called NOT_A_SPLIT with ratio ~1, 367 of them split-shaped (e.g. AAON 3:2 2011, ACIW 3:1 2014).
F3 (gap): a filing-wide scale error whose alternatives are scaled the same way is only caught by the absolute bound in 1.0.0; a deviation from the prior vintage did not trigger.
changes: S5: the scale hypothesis H1 is tested before H0 and every tier requires consistency with the prior vintage when one exists (tier A: v' within 2 % of a same-filing value and within 25 % of P1; without P1 tier A needs two distinct same-filing concepts within 2 %); H0 accepts v if it is within 25 % of P1, or (no P1) within 2 % of a same-filing outstanding value or of two distinct same-filing concepts.
S7: S_before must come from an accession filed before the event date (originally reported value, not a restated comparative); S_after is the first fact with raw end >= event date.

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The classification output of rule 1.0.1 (296 SCALE_ERROR, 679 UNRESOLVED, 253 GENUINE_CAPITAL_ACTION, 88 NOT_A_SPLIT) - still no factor-study or winners-study result on corrected data.
findings: F4 (logic error): P1 was the latest-end ECSO/CSSO fact of the latest earlier accession. When that fact was not itself a panel observation it was never sanitized; mis-scaled comparatives/alternatives there (e.g. SKT 85,916,070,000; SYK ~380; PW 1.6e9) made correct values look like 1,000x deviations: 15 SCALE_ERROR corrections moved a value that agreed with the issuer's previous observation, many correct values ended UNRESOLVED, and GENUINE_CAPITAL_ACTION mixed real capital actions (SPAC/reverse mergers) with erroneous prior facts.
changes: S2: P1 = the latest earlier observation of the issuer already validated by this rule (filed < O.filed, corrected value, excluded ones skipped, basis-converted from its raw date); P2 = the latest-end ECSO/CSSO fact of the latest earlier accession not equal to P1 (sanitized as before). Without a validated observation P1 falls back to the latest earlier accession as in 1.0.1.
S5: a scale correction additionally requires support(v') > support(v), where support counts the references within 25 %: one value per same-filing concept (end closest to D), P1 and P2.

S5 label: a triggered O whose v is confirmed by the same filing and whose P1 differs from v by a power of ten (within 25 %) is labelled PRIOR_VINTAGE_SCALE_ERROR instead of GENUINE_CAPITAL_ACTION (status unchanged: OK).

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The classification output of rule 1.0.2; the three remaining panel rows above 5e12 USD after correction (AMG 2010-12 to 2011-02, corrected to 5.1e12-5.5e12) - no study result on corrected data.
findings: F5 (logic error): for an issuer's first observation (no prior vintage) tier A accepted 'two distinct same-filing concepts'; at AMG 10-Q Q3 2010 these were WASO_B and WASO_D of the same income-statement table, both tagged x1000, and the correct ECSO 51,571,828 was multiplied by 1,000 (and became the prior vintage of the next filings).
changes: S5: WASO_B, WASO_D and WASO_BD count as one source family; wherever two distinct same-filing concepts are required (tier A without P1, H0 without P1) they must be two distinct families (ECSO, CSSO, WASO).

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The 1.0.3 classification of the cases named before rule 1.0.0 (EEFT, CB, ON, YUM, ORCL, Citigroup) - no study result on corrected data.
findings: F6 (interaction of 1.0.2 with tier B): CB 10-Q Q1 2010 is scaled x1e6 as a whole filing (ECSO and CSSO alike, comparative 2009-12-31 = 1e6 x the 10-K value). The 1.0.2 support count included the equally scaled same-filing ECSO, so support(v') = support(v) and the documented filing-wide error was excluded instead of corrected.
changes: S5: the support condition of 1.0.2 applies to tiers A and C as before; for tier B (filing-wide scale shown by comparatives) support is counted on the external references P1 and P2 only (support_ext(v') > support_ext(v)).

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The 1.0.4 split register (88 NOT_A_SPLIT): non-split-shaped factors are textbook spin-offs (GE 2023/2024, ALV 2018, ARMK 2023, T 2022, EXC 2022, DTE 2021, FTV 2020, WDC 2025 ...); 37 split-shaped factors (2:1, 3:2, 5:1, reverse splits of micro caps) also showed share continuity ~1 - no study result on corrected data.
findings: F7: share continuity ~1 for a split-shaped factor contradicts the split (cover-page timing, ADR ratio changes, delayed share issue) but is no evidence of a spin-off; removing such a factor would be an unsupported correction.
changes: S7: NOT_A_SPLIT only for factors that are not split-shaped; a split-shaped factor with continuity ~1 is CONTRADICTED_SPLIT. S8: a CONTRADICTED_SPLIT event between D and t whose evidence is available at t-1 makes the use SPLIT_BASIS_UNRESOLVED (EXCLUDED); before availability the provider split is kept as in V10.

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The first SEC source sample (56 observations drawn from the 1.0.5 register, docs/quant-recovery/v12/mcap/sec-sample-1.0.0.json): 2 of 30 sampled corrections were wrong (MSEX 10-Q Q3 2011: cover page 15,634,889 shares, corrected to 15,634.889; NBHC 10-K 2012: 52,327,672 shares, corrected to 52.3 bn). No study result on corrected data.
findings: F8: tier B trusted a comparison value of an earlier accession that was itself mis-scaled (NBHC: earlier CSSO 52.19 bn), and the 1.0.2 fallback took raw facts of the latest earlier accession as prior vintage when no validated observation existed.

F9: for an issuer's first observation, two same-filing families (CSSO and WASO, both presented 'in thousands', MSEX 10-Q Q2 2011) out-voted a correct cover-page count; the corrected market cap (USD 0.28 M) was implausible for a listed stock.
changes: S2: P1/P2 are only the issuer's latest earlier observations validated by this rule; there is no fallback to raw facts of earlier accessions.
S5 tier B: a comparison value of an earlier accession counts only if it agrees within 25 % with the validated prior vintage P1 (basis-converted to its date); without P1 there is no tier B.
S5 price plausibility: a scale candidate v' is admissible only if every use gives 1e6 <= market cap <= 8e12 USD.
amendments.validation: Superseded: the sample drawn for 1.0.6 (tag final, docs/quant-recovery/v12/mcap/sec-sample-final.json) became the second development sample because it led to 1.0.7.

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The second SEC source sample (56 observations from the 1.0.6 register, sec-sample-final.json): AAP 10-Q Q1 2011 cover page states 76,637,258 shares, the register had corrected the fact to 76,637.258. The first AAP observations were corrected on two statement values (CSSO 84,198 and WASO 85,394, both in thousands) without a prior vintage, and the error propagated through the validated history. Five other flagged cases (PSA, ARW, ANF, UNTY, SNDX) were confirmed corrections (cover page or tables state the count in thousands or with a typo). No study result on corrected data.
findings: F10: balance-sheet CSSO and income-statement WASO are both financial-statement tables presented in thousands; their agreement is not independent evidence against the cover-page count.
changes: S5: source families are COVER (dei ECSO) and STATEMENTS (CSSO, WASO_B, WASO_D, WASO_BD). Wherever two distinct families are required (tier A and H0 without prior vintage) this now means cover page and statements; the cover-page count itself can therefore only be scale-corrected with a validated prior vintage.
amendments.validation: A third, fresh SEC sample (tag validation) is drawn from the 1.0.7 register and reported as the validation sample; no rule change follows from it.

amendments.decidedAfterSeeing: The validation SEC sample of rule 1.0.7 (sec-sample-validation.json, 56 observations): 32 of 34 sampled corrections confirmed, 2 wrong, both with scale exponent |k| = 1 (FBP 10-Q Q3 2011: 204,245,196 shares after a capital raise, corrected to 20.4 M; AIRTP 10-Q 2019: 2,912,599 shares, corrected to 0.29 M next to a provider 1:10 factor). No study result on corrected data.
findings: F11: a factor of 10 or 100 between a share count and its references coincides with 1:10 reverse splits and tenfold capital actions; the evidence tiers cannot separate them.
changes: S5: a scale hypothesis with |k| < 3 is never applied; the observation is EXCLUDED as DECIMAL_SCALE_SUSPECTED. This only turns corrections into exclusions (13 observations in the 1.0.7 register); no new correction is introduced.
amendments.validation: The 1.0.7 validation sample is reported as the validation of 1.0.7. For 1.0.8 the sampled corrections that remain are 32/32 confirmed, but this is in-sample for the tightening and not an independent test.
